_readme: The operator's address book — the whitelist. Copy it to data/book.json (the container
reads /data/book.json; TESTNET_PROTOCOLS_FILE names the path) or set TESTNET_PROTOCOLS
to the same JSON inline.
An entry is a VAULT OF THIS INTERFACE, not a dApp: a contract that answers
stake(uint256), withdraw(uint256), and publishes a record by emitting
YieldDistributed(uint256 indexed epoch, uint256 rateE18). A record is what
get_protocol_list() reads: the YieldDistributed logs that address emitted in the last
TESTNET_LOOKBACK blocks (5000 by default). No log, no record, no price, no trade.
The two entries below are REAL Arbitrum One addresses, and they are here to be
DIAGNOSED, not traded. Aave's aToken and a Uniswap V3 pool are not vaults of this
interface: they emit no YieldDistributed, so the loop refuses them — which is the
honest answer, and why a fresh deployment prints 'book empty'.
python -m agent.trade.loop --book-report
says it per entry, against the live chain and the live market, and exits 4 when
nothing can be priced. Replace them with your own vault once it is deployed.
Each entry carries a 'pool' — the DeFiLlama uuid of the pool this address actually
implements, which is what lets TESTNET_HISTORY=auto (or =feed) price it from the
feed's own daily history instead of a name guess. Both uuids below were read out of
https://yields.llama.fi/pools and checked against the address: the Aave row's
underlyingTokens[0] is the USDC this aToken is a claim on, and the Uniswap row is the
0.05% WETH-USDC pool this address is (see poolMeta). With 'pool' pinned the entry
needs no name match at all; without it, 'name' has to be spelled like the pool.
Keys the loader reads: address, name, bucket, claim_apy, decimals, token, note, pool.
address   0x + 40 hex — the vault. Checked, and lower-cased.
name      the pool's own label: 'project symbol (chain)' exactly as DeFiLlama spells
it. The cycle matches a verdict to a vault by this name (normalised: letters
and digits), so 'USDC' does NOT match 'aave-v3 USDC (Arbitrum)'.
bucket    safe | active | experimental (agent.physics.portfolio.BUCKETS).
decimals  credits per token unit: 6 for USDC, 18 for an 18-decimal token.
token     the ERC20 the vault pulls on stake(); empty means the built-in default.
pool      optional DeFiLlama pool uuid: pins which pool prices this entry, so the
feed fallback matches a uuid instead of a label. Empty means 'match the
name', which is a heuristic the operator declares by spelling it well.
Keys starting with '_' are ignored by the loader and exist for the reader.

_template_for_your_vault.name: USDC
_template_for_your_vault.note: the vault this loop is allowed to stake into, and nothing else
